div.p: Curricular references preserve the official study plan, years, semesters, ECTS and options. Reviewed mappings connect that context to open courses and resources.
A content mapping does not award credits, academic equivalence or a qualification. FACODI complements formal learning.

FACODI grew from Marcelo's habit of studying with public videos and open resources. He brings together software engineering, open education and community participation through the Monynha Softwares ecosystem.
His work connects product design, curricular context, Odoo integrations and the platform's technical architecture.

aside.p: Good resources, corrections and learning experiences help the campus grow. There is room for your contribution.

article.p: Website, courses, portal, news and forum share the same platform and editorial records.
Edge Functions support resource ingestion and analysis pipelines, with reviewed results connected to Odoo.
Versioned modules, the theme and deployment make changes traceable and reproducible.
